data.name: Lubna
data.gender_notes: Lubna is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Storax tree; (also) a kind of milk
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic lubnā, the storax tree, from the root ل-ب-ن (l-b-n). Its root is ل-ب-ن (l-b-n). A classical Arabic female name. Lubna is a Arabic name meaning “Storax tree; (also) a kind of milk”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lubna expresses “Storax tree; (also) a kind of milk”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic lubnā, the storax tree, from the root ل-ب-ن (l-b-n).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubna total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
